import SamplerSupport016
import Run2.LawBinding
import Run2.ExactCounting

/- Unconditional support theorem for every public h. This does not assert
   an all-h small moment, nor source/API equivalence. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.SamplerAC016
open Finset FT1536.Geometry FT1536.Relation FT1536.PublicSimulation
open FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding FT1536.Run2.ExactCounting
open SamplerCode016 SamplerSupport016

theorem honest_positive_at_accepted (h : Rq) (z : BoxPair) (hz : Q (decode z)<B) :
    0<(SigmaMath.freshHonest h).mass (SigmaMath.syndrome h z,emit z) := by
  classical
  have hp := BadVerify.trial_positive (SigmaMath.syndrome h) z hz
  have hc := BadVerify.cap_first_positive _ z hp 15
  have hm := BadVerify.map_mass_ge (MathSign.cap (trial (SigmaMath.syndrome h)
    (SigmaMath.syndrome h z)) 16) (MathSign.emit emit) (some z)
  have hbody : 0<(signBody (SigmaMath.syndrome h) (SigmaMath.syndrome h z)).mass (emit z) :=
    hc.trans_le hm
  rw [honest_joint_body]
  exact mul_pos (by positivity) hbody

theorem all_h_ac (t : Tables) (h : Rq) (st : State) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
    Divergence.AC (samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h) := by
  classical
  intro output hz
  rw [samplerLaw,map_mass]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro tape _
  by_cases he : (sampler t).code h st m r tape=output
  · have hp := honest_positive_at_accepted h (selected t (seedEquiv tape)) (selected_norm t _)
    rw [←code_as_emission t h st m r tape,he,hz] at hp
    exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hp)
  · simp [he]

theorem no_none (t : Tables) (h c : Rq) (st : State) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
    (samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r).mass (c,none)=0 := by
  classical
  rw [samplerLaw,map_mass]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro tape _
  simp [sampler]

#print axioms honest_positive_at_accepted
#print axioms all_h_ac
#print axioms no_none
end FT1536.S05.SamplerAC016

import FiniteLaw016
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fin.Basic

namespace FT1536.S05.BitTapes016
open FT1536.Run2
abbrev Bits (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Bool

def split (a b : ℕ) : Bits (a+b) ≃ Bits a × Bits b :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr finSumFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl Bool)).trans
    (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow (Fin a) (Fin b) Bool)

def chunks (n k : ℕ) : Bits (n*k) ≃ (Fin n → Bits k) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr finProdFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl Bool)).trans
    (Equiv.curry (Fin n) (Fin k) Bool)

theorem split_uniform (a b : ℕ) : (Law.uniform : Law (Bits (a+b))).map (split a b)=Law.uniform :=
  uniform_equiv (split a b)
theorem chunks_uniform (n k : ℕ) : (Law.uniform : Law (Bits (n*k))).map (chunks n k)=Law.uniform :=
  uniform_equiv (chunks n k)

def value : (n : ℕ) → Bits n → ℕ
  | 0,_ => 0
  | n+1,tape => (if tape 0 then 1 else 0)+2*value n (fun i => tape i.succ)

theorem value_lt (n : ℕ) (tape : Bits n) : value n tape<2^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [value]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hh := ih (fun i => tape i.succ)
    simp only [value,pow_succ]
    split <;> omega

def word (n : ℕ) (tape : Bits n) : Fin (2^n) := ⟨value n tape,value_lt n tape⟩

theorem value_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (value n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro a b _; funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
    intro a b he
    have h0 : a 0=b 0 := by
      simp only [value] at he
      cases ha : a 0 <;> cases hb : b 0 <;> simp_all <;> omega
    have ht : (fun i => a i.succ)=(fun i => b i.succ) := by
      apply ih
      simp only [value,h0] at he
      omega
    funext i
    exact Fin.cases h0 (fun j => congrFun ht j) i

theorem word_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (word n) := by
  intro a b he
  exact value_injective n (congrArg Fin.val he)

theorem word_bijective (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (word n) := by
  apply (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card (word n)).mpr
  exact ⟨word_injective n,by simp [Bits,Fintype.card_fun]⟩

noncomputable def wordEquiv (n : ℕ) : Bits n ≃ Fin (2^n) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (word n) (word_bijective n)

theorem word_uniform (n : ℕ) : (Law.uniform : Law (Bits n)).map (word n)=Law.uniform :=
  uniform_equiv (wordEquiv n)

#print axioms split_uniform
#print axioms chunks_uniform
#print axioms value_lt
#print axioms value_injective
#print axioms word_injective
#print axioms word_bijective
#print axioms word_uniform
end FT1536.S05.BitTapes016

import ProgramLaw016
import RawConditioning016
import RawPairDomination016
import SamplerAC016
import SamplerInterface015

set_option maxRecDepth 8192
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxPairFintype

namespace FT1536.S05.ImplementationBridge016
open FT1536.Relation FT1536.PublicSimulation FT1536.Run2
open SamplerCode016 ProgramLaw016 ProductLaw016 RawConditioning016
open SamplerMassCondition014 CapExecution016 RejectionDomination016

/- These are local proof obligations, NOT supplied instances and NOT new
   cryptographic assumptions. Raw probability refers to the actual1024-bit code. -/
structure PairLeaves (t : Tables) : Prop where
  rejection : (trialLaw (pairTrial t)).mass none≤(7/16 : ℝ)
  raw : ∀ a,(trialLaw (pairTrial t)).mass (some a)≤
    (1-(trialLaw (pairTrial t)).mass none)*(1+1/2^100)*RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass a
  zero_mass : 1/(2 : ℝ)^23≤RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass zeroBlock

def CubeLeaf : Prop := ∀ z, cubeLaw.mass z≤CoarseBudget016.R*boundedRaw.mass z

theorem pair_domination (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) :
    ∀ a,(pairLaw t).mass a≤CoarseBudget016.pairFactor*RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass a := by
  rw [pair_law]
  exact RawPairDomination016.cap80_domination _ _ zeroBlock leaves.rejection leaves.raw leaves.zero_mass

theorem selected_domination (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) :
    ∀ z,(selectedLaw t).mass z≤(1+1/2^60)*boundedRaw.mass z := by
  have hv : ∀ z,(vectorPair (pairLaw t)).mass z≤CoarseBudget016.C*RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z :=
    vectorPair_domination (pairLaw t) CoarseBudget016.pairFactor
      (by norm_num [CoarseBudget016.pairFactor]) (pair_domination t leaves)
  have hg : ProgramLaw016.good=RawConditioning016.good := rfl
  have ht : RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event (fun z => ¬RawConditioning016.good z)≤CoarseBudget016.r :=
    global_tail_from_mass h hm
  have hc : CoarseBudget016.C*CoarseBudget016.r<1 :=
    CoarseBudget016.rejection_budget.2.1.trans_lt CoarseBudget016.rejection_budget.2.2
  have hh := CapDomination016.rejected_fallback_domination
    (vectorPair (pairLaw t)) RawProductLaw.rawLaw cubeLaw
    CoarseBudget016.C CoarseBudget016.r CoarseBudget016.R hv RawConditioning016.good
    raw_good_positive ht hc (by unfold CoarseBudget016.R; positivity) cube 196
  have he := selected_law t
  rw [hg] at he
  intro z
  rw [he]
  exact (hh z).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right CoarseBudget016.full_density_budget
    (boundedRaw.nonneg z))

@[instance_reducible] def canonicalBoxIndex : Fintype BoxPair := inferInstance
attribute [instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype
local instance : Fintype BoxPair := canonicalBoxIndex

theorem reply_domination (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) (st : State) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
    ∀ x,(FT1536.Run2.samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r).mass x≤
      (1+1/2^60)*(SigmaMath.freshPublic h).mass x := by
  classical
  rw [ProgramLaw016.sampler_law]
  have hh := FiniteLaw016.map_domination (selectedLaw t) boundedRaw (1+1/2^60)
    (selected_domination t leaves cube h hm) (fun z => (SigmaMath.syndrome h z,emit z))
  rw [mapped_conditioned] at hh
  exact hh

theorem full_certificate (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) (st : State) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
    Divergence.AC (FT1536.Run2.samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h) ∧
    Divergence.second (FT1536.Run2.samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h)≤1+1/2^47 :=
  FullMoment015.strengthened_joint_certificate h hm _ (reply_domination t leaves cube h hm st m r)

theorem on_keys (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (domain : Rq → Prop) (mass : ∀ h,domain h → MassCondition h) :
    KeySupport011.OnKeys domain (sampler t) (1/2^47) :=
  ⟨by norm_num,fun h _ st m r => SamplerAC016.all_h_ac t h st m r,
    fun h hh st m r => (full_certificate t leaves cube h (mass h hh) st m r).2⟩

#print axioms pair_domination
#print axioms selected_domination
#print axioms reply_domination
#print axioms full_certificate
#print axioms on_keys
#check PairLeaves
#check CubeLeaf
end FT1536.S05.ImplementationBridge016

import ProgramLaw016
import RawConditioning016
import RawPairDomination016

import SamplerInterface015

set_option maxRecDepth 8192
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxPairFintype

namespace FT1536.S05.ImplementationBridge016
open FT1536.Relation FT1536.PublicSimulation FT1536.Run2
open SamplerCode016 ProgramLaw016 ProductLaw016 RawConditioning016
open SamplerMassCondition014 CapExecution016 RejectionDomination016

/- These are local proof obligations, NOT supplied instances and NOT new
   cryptographic assumptions. Raw probability refers to the actual1024-bit code. -/
structure PairLeaves (t : Tables) : Prop where
  rejection : (trialLaw (pairTrial t)).mass none≤(7/16 : ℝ)
  raw : ∀ a,(trialLaw (pairTrial t)).mass (some a)≤
    (1-(trialLaw (pairTrial t)).mass none)*(1+1/2^100)*RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass a
  zero_mass : 1/(2 : ℝ)^23≤RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass zeroBlock

def CubeLeaf : Prop := ∀ z, cubeLaw.mass z≤CoarseBudget016.R*boundedRaw.mass z

theorem pair_domination (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) :
    ∀ a,(pairLaw t).mass a≤CoarseBudget016.pairFactor*RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass a := by
  rw [pair_law]
  exact RawPairDomination016.cap80_domination _ _ zeroBlock leaves.rejection leaves.raw leaves.zero_mass

theorem selected_domination (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) :
    ∀ z,(selectedLaw t).mass z≤(1+1/2^60)*boundedRaw.mass z := by
  have hv : ∀ z,(vectorPair (pairLaw t)).mass z≤CoarseBudget016.C*RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z :=
    vectorPair_domination (pairLaw t) CoarseBudget016.pairFactor
      (by norm_num [CoarseBudget016.pairFactor]) (pair_domination t leaves)
  have ht : RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event (fun z => ¬RawConditioning016.good z)≤CoarseBudget016.r :=
    global_tail_from_mass h hm
  have hc : CoarseBudget016.C*CoarseBudget016.r<1 :=
    CoarseBudget016.rejection_budget.2.1.trans_lt CoarseBudget016.rejection_budget.2.2
  have hh := CapDomination016.rejected_fallback_domination
    (vectorPair (pairLaw t)) RawProductLaw.rawLaw cubeLaw
    CoarseBudget016.C CoarseBudget016.r CoarseBudget016.R hv RawConditioning016.good
    raw_good_positive ht hc (by unfold CoarseBudget016.R; positivity) cube 196
  have he := selected_law t
  change selectedLaw t=fallbackLaw (reject (vectorPair (pairLaw t)) RawConditioning016.good) 196 cubeLaw at he
  intro z
  rw [he]
  exact (hh z).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right CoarseBudget016.full_density_budget
    (boundedRaw.nonneg z))

@[instance_reducible] def canonicalBoxIndex : Fintype BoxPair := inferInstance
attribute [instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype
local instance : Fintype BoxPair := canonicalBoxIndex

theorem reply_domination (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) (st : State) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
    ∀ x,(FT1536.Run2.samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r).mass x≤
      (1+1/2^60)*(SigmaMath.freshPublic h).mass x := by
  classical
  rw [ProgramLaw016.sampler_law]
  have hh := FiniteLaw016.map_domination (selectedLaw t) boundedRaw (1+1/2^60)
    (selected_domination t leaves cube h hm) (fun z => (SigmaMath.syndrome h z,emit z))
  rw [mapped_conditioned] at hh
  exact hh

theorem full_certificate (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) (st : State) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
    Divergence.AC (FT1536.Run2.samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h) ∧
    Divergence.second (FT1536.Run2.samplerLaw (sampler t) h st m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h)≤1+1/2^47 :=
  FullMoment015.strengthened_joint_certificate h hm _ (reply_domination t leaves cube h hm st m r)

theorem on_keys (t : Tables) (leaves : PairLeaves t) (cube : CubeLeaf)
    (domain : Rq → Prop) (mass : ∀ h,domain h → MassCondition h) :
    KeySupport011.OnKeys domain (sampler t) (1/2^47) :=
  ⟨by norm_num,fun h _ st m r => SamplerAC016.all_h_ac t h st m r,
    fun h hh st m r => (full_certificate t leaves cube h (mass h hh) st m r).2⟩

#print axioms selected_domination
#print axioms reply_domination
#print axioms full_certificate
#print axioms on_keys
#check PairLeaves
#check CubeLeaf
end FT1536.S05.ImplementationBridge016

import FiniteLaw016

/- Exact executable first-success selection on independent finite tapes.
   A fresh fallback is an additional independent input, never conditioned away. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.CapExecution016
open Finset FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding FiniteLaw016
variable {Coin A B : Type} [Fintype Coin] [Nonempty Coin] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]

def first (trial : Coin → Option A) : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Coin) → Option A
  | 0,_ => none
  | n+1,tape => match trial (tape 0) with
    | some x => some x
    | none => first trial n (fun i => tape i.succ)

theorem first_all_reject (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) (tape : Fin n → Coin)
    (h : ∀ i,trial (tape i)=none) : first trial n tape=none := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [first,h 0]
    exact ih (fun i => tape i.succ) (fun i => h i.succ)

theorem first_none_iff (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) (tape : Fin n → Coin) :
    first trial n tape=none ↔ ∀ i,trial (tape i)=none := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [first]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [first]
    cases hx : trial (tape 0) with
    | none =>
      rw [ih]
      constructor
      · intro hh i
        refine Fin.cases hx (fun j => hh j) i
      · intro hh i
        exact hh i.succ
    | some x =>
      constructor
      · intro hh; cases hh
      · intro hh
        have := hh 0
        rw [hx] at this
        cases this

theorem first_some_witness (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) (tape : Fin n → Coin) (a : A)
    (ha : first trial n tape=some a) : ∃ i,trial (tape i)=some a := by
  induction n with
  | zero => cases ha
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [first] at ha
    cases hx : trial (tape 0) with
    | none =>
      rw [hx] at ha
      obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := ih (fun i => tape i.succ) ha
      exact ⟨i.succ,hi⟩
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at ha
      exact ⟨0,hx.trans ha⟩

noncomputable def trialLaw (trial : Coin → Option A) : Law (Option A) := Law.uniform.map trial

theorem first_law (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Coin)).map (first trial n)=MathSign.cap (trialLaw trial) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact map_const _ none
  | succ n ih =>
    have he := uniform_equiv (consEquiv Coin n)
    rw [←he,FiniteLaw016.map_map,uniform_product_map]
    rw [MathSign.cap,trialLaw,FiniteLaw016.map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext coin
    cases hc : trial coin with
    | none =>
      change (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Coin)).map
        (fun tail => match trial coin with | some a => some a | none => first trial n tail)=_
      simp only [hc]
      exact ih
    | some a =>
      change (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Coin)).map
        (fun tail => match trial coin with | some a => some a | none => first trial n tail)=_
      simp only [hc]
      exact map_const _ (some a)

def finish (fallback : B → A) (input : Option A × B) : A :=
  match input.1 with | some a => a | none => fallback input.2

noncomputable def fallbackLaw (p : Law (Option A)) (n : ℕ) (u : Law A) : Law A :=
  (MathSign.cap p n).bind (fun x => match x with | some a => Law.pure a | none => u)

theorem fallback_mass (p : Law (Option A)) (n : ℕ) (u : Law A) (a : A) :
    (fallbackLaw p n u).mass a=
      p.mass none^n*u.mass a+(∑ i ∈ range n,p.mass none^i)*p.mass (some a) := by
  simp only [fallbackLaw,Law.bind,Fintype.sum_option,Law.pure]
  simp only [mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero,sum_ite_eq,mem_univ,ite_true]
  rw [MathSign.cap_none,MathSign.cap_some]

theorem fallback_mixture (p : Law (Option A)) (l u : Law A)
    (factor : ∀ a,p.mass (some a)=(1-p.mass none)*l.mass a) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (fallbackLaw p n u).mass a=(1-p.mass none^n)*l.mass a+p.mass none^n*u.mass a := by
  rw [fallback_mass,factor]
  have hg := MathSign.geometric_acceptance (p.mass none) n
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun t => t*l.mass a) hg]

theorem fallback_zero_cap (p : Law (Option A)) (u : Law A) : fallbackLaw p 0 u=u := by
  apply law_ext
  intro a
  simp [fallback_mass]

theorem fallback_code_law [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] (trial : Coin → Option A)
    (fallback : B → A) (n : ℕ) :
    (Law.uniform : Law ((Fin n → Coin)×B)).map
      (fun input => finish fallback (first trial n input.1,input.2))=
    fallbackLaw (trialLaw trial) n ((Law.uniform : Law B).map fallback) := by
  rw [uniform_product_map,fallbackLaw,←first_law,FiniteLaw016.map_bind]
  congr 1
  funext tape
  cases hx : first trial n tape with
  | none => simp only [hx,finish]
  | some a =>
    simp only [hx,finish]
    exact map_const _ a

#print axioms first_all_reject
#print axioms first_none_iff
#print axioms first_some_witness
#print axioms first_law
#print axioms fallback_mass
#print axioms fallback_mixture
#print axioms fallback_zero_cap
#print axioms fallback_code_law
end FT1536.S05.CapExecution016

import FiniteLaw016

/- Exact executable first-success selection on independent finite tapes.
   A fresh fallback is an additional independent input, never conditioned away. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.CapExecution016
open Finset FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding FiniteLaw016
variable {Coin A B : Type}

def first (trial : Coin → Option A) : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Coin) → Option A
  | 0,_ => none
  | n+1,tape => match trial (tape 0) with
    | some x => some x
    | none => first trial n (fun i => tape i.succ)

theorem first_all_reject (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) (tape : Fin n → Coin)
    (h : ∀ i,trial (tape i)=none) : first trial n tape=none := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [first,h 0]
    exact ih (fun i => tape i.succ) (fun i => h i.succ)

theorem first_none_iff (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) (tape : Fin n → Coin) :
    first trial n tape=none ↔ ∀ i,trial (tape i)=none := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [first]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [first]
    cases hx : trial (tape 0) with
    | none =>
      rw [ih]
      constructor
      · intro hh i
        refine Fin.cases hx (fun j => hh j) i
      · intro hh i
        exact hh i.succ
    | some x =>
      constructor
      · intro hh; cases hh
      · intro hh
        have := hh 0
        rw [hx] at this
        cases this

theorem first_some_witness (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) (tape : Fin n → Coin) (a : A)
    (ha : first trial n tape=some a) : ∃ i,trial (tape i)=some a := by
  induction n with
  | zero => cases ha
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [first] at ha
    cases hx : trial (tape 0) with
    | none =>
      rw [hx] at ha
      obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := ih (fun i => tape i.succ) ha
      exact ⟨i.succ,hi⟩
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at ha
      exact ⟨0,hx.trans ha⟩

variable [Fintype Coin] [Nonempty Coin] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]

noncomputable def trialLaw (trial : Coin → Option A) : Law (Option A) := Law.uniform.map trial

theorem first_law (trial : Coin → Option A) (n : ℕ) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Coin)).map (first trial n)=MathSign.cap (trialLaw trial) n := by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => exact map_const _ none
  | succ n ih =>
    have he := uniform_equiv (consEquiv Coin n)
    rw [←he,FiniteLaw016.map_map,uniform_product_map]
    rw [MathSign.cap,trialLaw,FiniteLaw016.map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext coin
    cases hc : trial coin with
    | none =>
      change (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Coin)).map
        (fun tail => match trial coin with | some a => some a | none => first trial n tail)=_
      simp only [hc]
      exact ih
    | some a =>
      change (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Coin)).map
        (fun tail => match trial coin with | some a => some a | none => first trial n tail)=_
      simp only [hc]
      exact map_const _ (some a)

def finish (fallback : B → A) (input : Option A × B) : A :=
  match input.1 with | some a => a | none => fallback input.2

noncomputable def fallbackLaw (p : Law (Option A)) (n : ℕ) (u : Law A) : Law A :=
  (MathSign.cap p n).bind (fun x => match x with | some a => Law.pure a | none => u)

theorem fallback_mass (p : Law (Option A)) (n : ℕ) (u : Law A) (a : A) :
    (fallbackLaw p n u).mass a=
      p.mass none^n*u.mass a+(∑ i ∈ range n,p.mass none^i)*p.mass (some a) := by
  simp only [fallbackLaw,Law.bind,Fintype.sum_option,Law.pure]
  simp only [mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero,sum_ite_eq,mem_univ,ite_true]
  rw [MathSign.cap_none,MathSign.cap_some]

theorem fallback_mixture (p : Law (Option A)) (l u : Law A)
    (factor : ∀ a,p.mass (some a)=(1-p.mass none)*l.mass a) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (fallbackLaw p n u).mass a=(1-p.mass none^n)*l.mass a+p.mass none^n*u.mass a := by
  rw [fallback_mass,factor]
  have hg := MathSign.geometric_acceptance (p.mass none) n
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun t => t*l.mass a) hg]

theorem fallback_zero_cap (p : Law (Option A)) (u : Law A) : fallbackLaw p 0 u=u := by
  apply law_ext
  intro a
  simp [fallback_mass]

theorem fallback_code_law [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] (trial : Coin → Option A)
    (fallback : B → A) (n : ℕ) :
    (Law.uniform : Law ((Fin n → Coin)×B)).map
      (fun input => finish fallback (first trial n input.1,input.2))=
    fallbackLaw (trialLaw trial) n ((Law.uniform : Law B).map fallback) := by
  rw [uniform_product_map,fallbackLaw,←first_law,FiniteLaw016.map_bind]
  congr 1
  funext tape
  cases hx : first trial n tape with
  | none => simp only [hx,finish]
  | some a =>
    simp only [hx,finish]
    exact map_const _ a

#print axioms first_all_reject
#print axioms first_none_iff
#print axioms first_some_witness
#print axioms first_law
#print axioms fallback_mass
#print axioms fallback_mixture
#print axioms fallback_zero_cap
#print axioms fallback_code_law
end FT1536.S05.CapExecution016

variable {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]

theorem pure_domination (g : Law A) (a : A) (ha : 0<g.mass a) :
    ∀ x,(Law.pure a).mass x≤(1/g.mass a)*g.mass x := by
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x=a
  · subst x; simp [Law.pure,ne_of_gt ha]
  · simp only [Law.pure,hx,ite_false]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (g.nonneg x)

theorem fallback_domination (trial : Law (Option A)) (l u g : Law A)
    (factor : ∀ a,trial.mass (some a)=(1-trial.mass none)*l.mass a)
    (K r R : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) (hR : 0≤R)
    (hl : ∀ a,l.mass a≤K*g.mass a) (hu : ∀ a,u.mass a≤R*g.mass a)
    (tail : trial.mass none≤r) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ a,(fallbackLaw trial n u).mass a≤(K+r^n*R)*g.mass a := by
  intro a
  rw [fallback_mixture trial l u factor]
  have hrn : trial.mass none^n≤r^n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (trial.nonneg none) tail n
  have h1 : (1-trial.mass none^n)*l.mass a≤l.mass a := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (trial.nonneg none) n) (l.nonneg a)]
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu a) (pow_nonneg (trial.nonneg none) n)
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrn (mul_nonneg hR (g.nonneg a))
  nlinarith [hl a]

theorem rejected_fallback_domination (p q fallback : Law A) (C r R : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ a,p.mass a≤C*q.mass a) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    (hq : 0<q.event good) (tail : q.event (fun a => ¬good a)≤r)
    (cap : C*r<1) (hR : 0≤R)
    (hu : ∀ a,fallback.mass a≤R*(conditioned q good hq).mass a) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ a,(fallbackLaw (reject p good) n fallback).mass a≤
      (1+(C-1)/(1-C*r)+(C*r)^n*R)*(conditioned q good hq).mass a := by
  have hC := domination_one_le p q C hd
  have hr : 0≤r := (q.event_nonneg (fun a => ¬good a)).trans tail
  have hp : 0<p.event good := (by linarith : 0<1-C*r).trans_le (acceptance_lower p q C r hd good tail)
  apply fallback_domination (reject p good) (conditioned p good hp) fallback
    (conditioned q good hq) (reject_factor p good hp) _ (C*r) R
    (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hr) hR
    (conditioned_domination p q C r hd good hp hq tail cap) hu
  rw [reject_none]
  exact (event_domination p q C hd _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left tail (by linarith))

#print axioms pure_domination
#print axioms fallback_domination
#print axioms rejected_fallback_domination
end FT1536.S05.CapDomination016

import BitTapes016
import CapExecution016
import Run2.PolynomialReference

set_option maxRecDepth 8192

/- Computable finite-tape reference for007. CDF search is explicit linear
   first-hit search; it is not assigned the bisect implementation's cost.
   Tables are public data parameters, not ideal real Gaussian oracles. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.SamplerCode016
open FT1536.Geometry FT1536.PublicSimulation FT1536.Relation FT1536.Run2
open BitTapes016 CapExecution016

abbrev CoordIndex := Fin 30721
abbrev PairIndex := Fin 61441
abbrev Block := Fin 131071 × Fin 131071
structure Tables where
  cdf : CoordIndex → ℕ
  threshold : PairIndex → ℕ

def coord (t : Tables) (w : Bits 384) : CoordIndex :=
  let residue := (word 384 w).val % t.cdf ⟨30720,by decide⟩
  ((List.finRange 30721).find? (fun i => residue<t.cdf i)).getD ⟨30720,by decide⟩

def embedCoord (i : CoordIndex) : Fin 131071 := ⟨i.val+50175,by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
def zeroBlock : Block := (⟨65535,by decide⟩,⟨65535,by decide⟩)
abbrev PairBits := Bits 384 × (Bits 384 × Bits 256)
abbrev PairSeed := Fin 80 → PairBits
abbrev VectorSeed := (Fin 768 → PairSeed) × (Fin 768 → PairSeed)
abbrev NormSeed := Fin 196 → VectorSeed
abbrev CubeSeed := (Fin 768 → Bits 10 × Bits 10) × (Fin 768 → Bits 10 × Bits 10)
abbrev Seed := NormSeed × CubeSeed

def pairTrial (t : Tables) (coins : PairBits) : Option Block :=
  let x := coord t coins.1
  let y := coord t coins.2.1
  if (word 256 coins.2.2).val<t.threshold ⟨x.val+y.val,by have := x.isLt; have := y.isLt; omega⟩
    then some (embedCoord x,embedCoord y) else none

def pair (t : Tables) (coins : PairSeed) : Block :=
  (first (pairTrial t) 80 coins).getD zeroBlock

def vector (t : Tables) (coins : VectorSeed) : BoxPair :=
  (fun i => pair t (coins.1 i),fun i => pair t (coins.2 i))

def normTrial (t : Tables) (coins : VectorSeed) : Option BoxPair :=

import FiniteLaw016

/- A finite mathematical negative control, not a production sampler test.
   Rejected coin b reused via1-b gives a different law from a fresh coin. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.ControlFallback016
open FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding

def shared (b : Bool) : Bool := if b then true else !b
def fresh (coins : Bool×Bool) : Bool := if coins.1 then true else !coins.2

theorem shared_one : ((Law.uniform : Law Bool).map shared).mass true=1 := by
  rw [map_mass]
  norm_num [shared,Law.uniform,Fintype.sum_bool]

theorem fresh_three_quarters : ((Law.uniform : Law (Bool×Bool)).map fresh).mass true=3/4 := by
  rw [map_mass]
  norm_num [fresh,Law.uniform,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_bool]

theorem correlation_changes_law : (Law.uniform : Law Bool).map shared≠
    (Law.uniform : Law (Bool×Bool)).map fresh := by
  intro he
  have hh := congrArg (fun p : Law Bool => p.mass true) he
  rw [shared_one,fresh_three_quarters] at hh
  norm_num at hh

#print axioms shared_one
#print axioms fresh_three_quarters
#print axioms correlation_changes_law
end FT1536.S05.ControlFallback016

import Run2.TargetLaw

/- Q-SAMPLER proof obligation: exact finite pushforwards, no approximation. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.FiniteLaw016
open Finset FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding
variable {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C]

theorem map_const [DecidableEq B] (p : Law A) (b : B) : p.map (fun _ => b)=Law.pure b := by
  apply law_ext
  intro x
  rw [map_mass]
  by_cases hx : b=x
  · subst x; simp [p.total,Law.pure]
  · simp [hx,Ne.symm hx,Law.pure]

theorem bind_pure [DecidableEq A] (p : Law A) : p.bind Law.pure=p := by
  apply law_ext
  intro x
  simp [Law.bind,Law.pure]

theorem map_bind [DecidableEq B] (p : Law A) (f : A → B) (k : B → Law C) :
    (p.map f).bind k=p.bind (fun x => k (f x)) := by
  apply law_ext
  intro z
  simp only [Law.bind,map_mass]
  simp_rw [sum_mul]
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  simp [ite_mul]

theorem map_map [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq C] (p : Law A) (f : A → B) (g : B → C) :
    (p.map f).map g=p.map (g ∘ f) :=
  map_bind p f (fun x => Law.pure (g x))

theorem joint_map [DecidableEq C] (p : Law A) (q : Law B) (f : A×B → C) :
    (Divergence.joint p (fun _ => q)).map f=p.bind (fun a => q.map (fun b => f (a,b))) := by
  apply law_ext
  intro c
  simp only [Law.map,Law.bind,Divergence.joint,Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [mul_sum,mul_assoc]

theorem uniform_product_map [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] [DecidableEq C] (f : A×B → C) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (A×B)).map f=(Law.uniform : Law A).bind
      (fun a => (Law.uniform : Law B).map (fun b => f (a,b))) := by
  rw [←uniform_joint]
  exact joint_map _ _ _

theorem map_domination [DecidableEq B] (p q : Law A) (K : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ a,p.mass a≤K*q.mass a) (f : A → B) :
    ∀ b,(p.map f).mass b≤K*(q.map f).mass b := by
  intro b
  rw [map_mass,map_mass,mul_sum]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : f a=b
  · simpa only [ha,ite_true] using h a
  · simp [ha]

#print axioms map_const
#print axioms bind_pure
#print axioms map_bind
#print axioms map_map
#print axioms joint_map
#print axioms uniform_product_map
#print axioms map_domination
end FT1536.S05.FiniteLaw016

  cases Subsingleton.elim I J

    (p : Law A) (q : Law B) : Divergence.joint p (fun _ => q)=p.bind (fun a => q.map (fun b => (a,b))) := by
  have hh := joint_map p q id
  change (Divergence.joint p (fun _ => q)).bind Law.pure=_ at hh
  rw [bind_pure] at hh
  exact hh

    [DecidableEq C] [DecidableEq D] (p : Law A) (q : Law B) (f : A → C) (g : B → D) :
    (Divergence.joint p (fun _ => q)).map (fun z => (f z.1,g z.2))=
      Divergence.joint (p.map f) (fun _ => q.map g) := by
  rw [joint_map,joint_as_bind,FiniteLaw016.map_bind]
  congr 1
  funext a
  rw [FiniteLaw016.map_map]
  rfl

noncomputable def pairLaw (t : Tables) : Law Block :=
  (Law.uniform : Law PairSeed).map (pair t)
noncomputable def vectorLaw (t : Tables) : Law BoxPair :=
  (Law.uniform : Law VectorSeed).map (vector t)
noncomputable def cubeLaw : Law BoxPair :=
  (Law.uniform : Law CubeSeed).map cube
noncomputable def selectedLaw (t : Tables) : Law BoxPair :=
  (Law.uniform : Law Seed).map (selected t)

theorem pair_law (t : Tables) : pairLaw t=
    fallbackLaw (trialLaw (pairTrial t)) 80 (Law.pure zeroBlock) := by
  have he : pair t=(fun o : Option Block => o.getD zeroBlock) ∘ first (pairTrial t) 80 := rfl
  rw [pairLaw,he,←FiniteLaw016.map_map,first_law]
  change (MathSign.cap (trialLaw (pairTrial t)) 80).bind _=_
  unfold fallbackLaw
  congr 1
  funext o
  cases o <;> rfl

  change (Law.uniform : Law VectorSeed).map
    (fun z => ((fun i => pair t (z.1 i)),(fun i => pair t (z.2 i))))=_
  rw [←uniform_joint,map_product,independent_code]
  rfl

def good (z : BoxPair) : Prop := Geometry.Q (decode z)<Geometry.B
instance : DecidablePred good := fun _ => inferInstance

theorem norm_trial_law (t : Tables) : trialLaw (normTrial t)=
    RejectionDomination016.reject (vectorPair (pairLaw t)) good := by
  change (Law.uniform : Law VectorSeed).map (RejectionDomination016.accept good ∘ vector t)=_

  change (vectorLaw t).map (RejectionDomination016.accept good)=_
  rw [vector_law]
  rfl

  rw [norm_trial_law] at hh
  exact hh

  rw [samplerLaw,he,←FiniteLaw016.map_map,←FiniteLaw016.map_map,seed_uniform]
  rfl

import FT1536.Relation
import Mathlib.Tactic.ComputeDegree
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision

set_option maxRecDepth 32768
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

namespace FT1536.Run2.PolynomialReference
open Polynomial FT1536.Relation
abbrev F := ZMod 18433
instance : Fact ((1 : ℕ)<18433) := ⟨by decide⟩

theorem modulus_monic : (modulus : Polynomial F).Monic := by
  unfold modulus
  monicity <;> norm_num

theorem modulus_degree : (modulus : Polynomial F).degree=1536 := by
  unfold modulus
  compute_degree <;> norm_num

theorem low_remainder (i : ℕ) (hi : i<1536) : (X^i : Polynomial F)%ₘmodulus=X^i := by
  apply (modByMonic_eq_self_iff modulus_monic).2
  rw [degree_X_pow,modulus_degree]
  exact_mod_cast hi

theorem first_remainder (i : ℕ) (hi : i<768) :
    (X^(i+1536) : Polynomial F)%ₘmodulus=X^(i+768)-X^i := by
  have hd : modulus ∣ (X^(i+1536) : Polynomial F)-(X^(i+768)-X^i) := by
    refine ⟨X^i,?_⟩
    unfold modulus
    simp only [pow_add]
    ring
  rw [modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub modulus_monic hd]
  apply (modByMonic_eq_self_iff modulus_monic).2
  apply (degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt
  rw [modulus_degree]
  apply max_lt
  · rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast (show i+768<1536 by omega)
  · rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast (show i<1536 by omega)

theorem second_remainder (i : ℕ) (hi : i<768) :
    (X^(i+2304) : Polynomial F)%ₘmodulus= -X^i := by
  have hp2 := pow_mul (X : Polynomial F) 768 2
  have hp3 := pow_mul (X : Polynomial F) 768 3
  norm_num only [Nat.reduceMul] at hp2 hp3
  have hd : modulus ∣ (X^(i+2304) : Polynomial F)-(-X^i) := by
    refine ⟨X^(i+768)+X^i,?_⟩
    unfold modulus
    simp only [pow_add,hp2,hp3]
    ring
  rw [modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub modulus_monic hd]
  apply (modByMonic_eq_self_iff modulus_monic).2
  rw [degree_neg,degree_X_pow,modulus_degree]
  exact_mod_cast (show i<1536 by omega)

/- Only three cases and at most two coefficient writes per monomial. -/
def remainderTerms (k : Fin 3072) : List (Fin 1536 × F) :=
  if h : k.val<1536 then [(⟨k.val,h⟩,1)]
  else if h' : k.val<2304 then
    [(⟨k.val-768,by omega⟩,1),(⟨k.val-1536,by omega⟩,-1)]
  else [(⟨k.val-2304,by omega⟩,-1)]

noncomputable def termsPoly (xs : List (Fin 1536 × F)) : Polynomial F :=
  (xs.map (fun z => C z.2 * X^z.1.val)).sum

theorem remainderTerms_correct (k : Fin 3072) :
    termsPoly (remainderTerms k)=(X^k.val : Polynomial F)%ₘmodulus := by
  unfold remainderTerms
  split
  next h => simp [termsPoly,low_remainder k.val h]
  next h =>
    split
    next h' =>
      have hi : k.val-1536<768 := by omega
      have hk : k.val=(k.val-1536)+1536 := by omega
      have hr := first_remainder (k.val-1536) hi
      rw [←hk] at hr
      rw [hr]
      have he : k.val-768=k.val-1536+768 := by omega
      simp [termsPoly,he,sub_eq_add_neg]
    next h' =>
      have hi : k.val-2304<768 := by have hn:=k.isLt; omega
      have hk : k.val=(k.val-2304)+2304 := by omega
      have hr := second_remainder (k.val-2304) hi
      rw [←hk] at hr
      rw [hr]
      simp [termsPoly]

theorem remainder_writes_at_most_two (k : Fin 3072) : (remainderTerms k).length≤2 := by
  unfold remainderTerms
  split
  · simp
  · split <;> simp

abbrev TermIndex := Fin 768 × Bool
/- Keep the executable finite enumeration opaque to kernel unification;
otherwise elaboration tries to expand millions of concrete list elements.
Its complete enumeration is still the ordinary product Fintype. -/
opaque termFinite : Fintype TermIndex := instFintypeProd (Fin 768) Bool
attribute [instance] termFinite
def exponent (i : TermIndex) : ℕ := i.1.val+if i.2 then 768 else 0
def coefficient (a : Rq) (i : TermIndex) : F := if i.2 then (a i.1).2 else (a i.1).1

theorem exponent_lt (i : TermIndex) : exponent i<1536 := by
  unfold exponent
  have hh := i.1.isLt
  split <;> omega

def productExponent (i j : TermIndex) : Fin 3072 :=
  ⟨exponent i+exponent j,by have hi:=exponent_lt i; have hj:=exponent_lt j; omega⟩

def coefficientOfTerms (xs : List (Fin 1536 × F)) (r : Fin 1536) : F :=
  (xs.map (fun t => if t.1=r then t.2 else 0)).sum

/- A concrete, computable coefficient loop; it contains no Polynomial or
noncomputable normalizer operation. Each (i,j) has ≤2 reduced monomials. -/
def multiplyCoefficient (a b : Rq) (r : Fin 1536) : F :=
  ∑ i : TermIndex, ∑ j : TermIndex,
    coefficient a i*coefficient b j*coefficientOfTerms (remainderTerms (productExponent i j)) r

def multiply (a b : Rq) : Rq := fun i =>
  (multiplyCoefficient a b ⟨i.val,by have hh:=i.isLt; omega⟩,
   multiplyCoefficient a b ⟨i.val+768,by have hh:=i.isLt; omega⟩)

theorem coefficientOfTerms_correct (xs : List (Fin 1536 × F)) (r : Fin 1536) :
    (termsPoly xs).coeff r.val=coefficientOfTerms xs r := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [termsPoly,coefficientOfTerms]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [termsPoly,coefficientOfTerms,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,coeff_add,coeff_C_mul,coeff_X_pow] at *
    rw [ih]
    by_cases hx : x.1=r
    · simp [hx]
    · have hn : x.1.val≠r.val := fun hh => hx (Fin.ext hh)
      simp [hx,Ne.symm hn]

theorem poly_as_terms (a : Rq) : poly a =
    ∑ i : TermIndex, C (coefficient a i)*X^(exponent i) := by
  have hi : termFinite=instFintypeProd (Fin 768) Bool := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hi]
  simp [poly,Fintype.sum_prod_type,coefficient,exponent,add_comm]

theorem remainder_sum {I : Type} (s : Finset I) (p : I → Polynomial F) :
    (∑ i∈s,p i)%ₘmodulus=∑ i∈s,p i%ₘmodulus := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih => simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha,add_modByMonic,ih]

theorem product_remainder_terms (a b : Rq) :
    (poly a*poly b)%ₘmodulus =
      ∑ i : TermIndex, ∑ j : TermIndex,
        C (coefficient a i*coefficient b j)*termsPoly (remainderTerms (productExponent i j)) := by
  rw [poly_as_terms,poly_as_terms,Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum,remainder_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hm : C (coefficient a i)*X^(exponent i)*(C (coefficient b j)*X^(exponent j)) =
      C (coefficient a i*coefficient b j)*X^(exponent i+exponent j) := by
    rw [map_mul,pow_add]
    ring
  rw [hm,←smul_eq_C_mul,smul_modByMonic,smul_eq_C_mul,remainderTerms_correct]
  rfl

theorem multiplyCoefficient_correct (a b : Rq) (r : Fin 1536) :
    multiplyCoefficient a b r=((poly a*poly b)%ₘmodulus).coeff r.val := by
  rw [product_remainder_terms]
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [coeff_C_mul,coefficientOfTerms_correct]

theorem multiply_correct (a b : Rq) : multiply a b=mulRq a b := by
  funext i
  exact Prod.ext (multiplyCoefficient_correct a b _) (multiplyCoefficient_correct a b _)

theorem term_count : Fintype.card TermIndex=1536 := by
  have hi : termFinite=instFintypeProd (Fin 768) Bool := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hi]
  simp [TermIndex,Fintype.card_prod]

theorem coefficient_loop_iterations :
    (∑ _i : TermIndex, ∑ _j : TermIndex,(1 : ℕ))=1536*1536 := by
  simp [term_count]

theorem reduced_term_visits :
    (∑ i : TermIndex, ∑ j : TermIndex,(remainderTerms (productExponent i j)).length)≤2*1536*1536 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : TermIndex, ∑ _j : TermIndex,(2 : ℕ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact remainder_writes_at_most_two _
    _ = _ := by simp [term_count]

end FT1536.Run2.PolynomialReference

import FiniteLaw016
import Run2.RawProductLaw

namespace FT1536.S05.ProductLaw016
open Finset FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding FiniteLaw016
variable {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]

noncomputable def product (p : Law A) (n : ℕ) : Law (Fin n → A) where
  mass v := ∏ i,p.mass (v i)
  nonneg v := prod_nonneg (fun i _ => p.nonneg (v i))
  total := by
    rw [←Fintype.prod_sum]
    simp only [p.total,prod_const_one]

theorem product_uniform [Nonempty A] (n : ℕ) :
    product (Law.uniform : Law A) n=Law.uniform := by
  apply law_ext
  intro v
  simp [product,Law.uniform,Fintype.card_fun,one_div_pow]

theorem product_map [DecidableEq B] (p : Law A) (f : A → B) (n : ℕ) :
    (product p n).map (fun v i => f (v i))=product (p.map f) n := by
  classical
  apply law_ext
  intro v
  rw [map_mass]
  change (∑ x : Fin n → A, if (fun i => f (x i))=v then ∏ i,p.mass (x i) else 0)=
    ∏ i,(p.map f).mass (v i)
  simp_rw [map_mass]
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  by_cases hx : (fun i => f (x i))=v
  · have hi : ∀ i,f (x i)=v i := congrFun hx
    simp [hx,hi]
  · have hi : ∃ i,f (x i)≠v i := by
      by_contra hh
      push_neg at hh
      exact hx (funext hh)
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hi
    rw [if_neg hx]
    symm
    exact prod_eq_zero (mem_univ i) (by simp [hi])

theorem independent_code [Nonempty A] [DecidableEq B] (f : A → B) (n : ℕ) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → A)).map (fun v i => f (v i))=
      product ((Law.uniform : Law A).map f) n := by
  rw [←product_uniform]
  exact product_map _ _ _

theorem product_domination (p q : Law A) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0≤K)
    (hd : ∀ a,p.mass a≤K*q.mass a) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → A) :
    (product p n).mass v≤K^n*(product q n).mass v := by
  change (∏ i,p.mass (v i))≤K^n*∏ i,q.mass (v i)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∏ i,K*q.mass (v i) := prod_le_prod (fun i _ => p.nonneg (v i)) (fun i _ => hd (v i))
    _ = _ := by rw [prod_mul_distrib]; simp

/- Reuse the ROM Gaussian tensor identity on the actual two 768-pair halves. -/
noncomputable def vectorPair (p : Law RawProductLaw.Block) : Law PublicSimulation.BoxPair :=
  Divergence.joint (product p 768) (fun _ => product p 768)

theorem gaussian_vectorPair : vectorPair RawProductLaw.blockLaw=RawProductLaw.rawLaw := by
  apply law_ext
  intro z
  rw [RawProductLaw.actual_mass_product]
  rfl

theorem vectorPair_domination (p : Law RawProductLaw.Block) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0≤K)
    (hd : ∀ a,p.mass a≤K*RawProductLaw.blockLaw.mass a) (z : PublicSimulation.BoxPair) :
    (vectorPair p).mass z≤K^1536*RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z := by
  rw [←gaussian_vectorPair]
  change (product p 768).mass z.1*(product p 768).mass z.2≤
    K^1536*((product RawProductLaw.blockLaw 768).mass z.1*(product RawProductLaw.blockLaw 768).mass z.2)
  have hh := mul_le_mul (product_domination p _ K hK hd 768 z.1)
    (product_domination p _ K hK hd 768 z.2) ((product p 768).nonneg z.2)
    (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hK _) ((product _ 768).nonneg z.1))
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

#print axioms product_uniform
#print axioms product_map
#print axioms independent_code
#print axioms product_domination
#print axioms gaussian_vectorPair
#print axioms vectorPair_domination
end FT1536.S05.ProductLaw016

import RejectionDomination016

attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype

namespace FT1536.S05.RawConditioning016
open Finset FT1536.PublicSimulation FT1536.Geometry FT1536.Relation
open FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.LegalKeyErrorTransfer
open RejectionDomination016 AcceptedMarginal015 SamplerMassCondition014

def good (z : BoxPair) : Prop := Q (decode z)<B
instance : DecidablePred good := fun z => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (Q (decode z)<B))

theorem raw_mass (z : BoxPair) : RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z=gaussianWeight z/totalWeight := by
  change gaussianWeight z/(∑ y,gaussianWeight y)=_
  rw [←RawProductLaw.totalWeight_as_sum]

theorem raw_good_event : RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event good=acceptedTotal/totalWeight := by
  unfold Law.event
  simp_rw [raw_mass]
  have he (z : BoxPair) : (if good z then gaussianWeight z/totalWeight else 0)=boundedWeight z/totalWeight := by
    by_cases hz : good z <;> simp [hz,boundedWeight,good] at *
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [←sum_div]
  unfold acceptedTotal
  rw [RawProductLaw.legacy_box_sum]

theorem raw_good_positive : 0<RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event good := by
  rw [raw_good_event]
  exact div_pos bounded_normalizer_pos totalWeight_pos

theorem conditioned_mass (z : BoxPair) :
    (conditioned RawProductLaw.rawLaw good raw_good_positive).mass z=boundedGaussian.mass z := by
  change (if good z then RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z else 0)/RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event good=
    boundedWeight z/acceptedTotal
  rw [raw_mass,raw_good_event]
  have hS : acceptedTotal≠0 := ne_of_gt bounded_normalizer_pos
  have hT : totalWeight≠0 := ne_of_gt totalWeight_pos
  by_cases hz : good z
  · have he : boundedWeight z=gaussianWeight z := ite_eq_left hz
    rw [ite_eq_left hz,he]
    field_simp
  · have he : boundedWeight z=0 := ite_eq_right hz
    rw [ite_eq_right hz,he]
    simp

theorem mapped_conditioned {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (f : BoxPair → X) :
    (conditioned RawProductLaw.rawLaw good raw_good_positive).map f=boundedGaussian.map f := by
  apply FiberBinding.law_ext
  intro x
  rw [FiberBinding.map_mass,FiberBinding.map_mass]
  simp_rw [conditioned_mass]
  exact (RawProductLaw.legacy_box_sum (fun z => if f z=x then boundedGaussian.mass z else 0)).symm

/-- The already named M suffices; no new global theta estimate is assumed. -/
theorem global_tail_from_mass (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) :
    RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event (fun z => ¬good z)≤1/2^24 := by
  have hs := (total_bounds h hm).1
  have hc := complement RawProductLaw.rawLaw good
  rw [raw_good_event] at hc
  have hlo : 1-u≤acceptedTotal/totalWeight :=
    (le_div_iff₀ totalWeight_pos).mpr hs
  change RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event (fun z => ¬good z)≤u
  linarith

#print axioms raw_mass
#print axioms raw_good_event
#print axioms raw_good_positive
#print axioms conditioned_mass
#print axioms mapped_conditioned
#print axioms global_tail_from_mass
end FT1536.S05.RawConditioning016

import RejectionDomination016
import Run2.RawProductLaw
import AcceptedMarginal015

set_option maxRecDepth 16384
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxPairFintype

namespace FT1536.S05.RawConditioning016
open Finset FT1536.PublicSimulation FT1536.Geometry FT1536.Relation
open FT1536.Run2 FT1536.Run2.LegalKeyErrorTransfer
open RejectionDomination016 AcceptedMarginal015 SamplerMassCondition014

def good (z : BoxPair) : Prop := Q (decode z)<B
instance : DecidablePred good := fun z => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (Q (decode z)<B))

theorem raw_mass (z : BoxPair) : RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z=gaussianWeight z/totalWeight := by
  change gaussianWeight z/(∑ y,gaussianWeight y)=_
  rw [←RawProductLaw.totalWeight_as_sum]

theorem raw_good_event : RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event good=acceptedTotal/totalWeight := by
  unfold Law.event
  simp_rw [raw_mass]
  have he (z : BoxPair) : (if good z then gaussianWeight z/totalWeight else 0)=boundedWeight z/totalWeight := by
    by_cases hz : good z
    · change (if good z then gaussianWeight z/totalWeight else 0)=(if good z then gaussianWeight z else 0)/totalWeight
      simp only [hz,ite_true]
    · change (if good z then gaussianWeight z/totalWeight else 0)=(if good z then gaussianWeight z else 0)/totalWeight
      simp only [hz,ite_false,zero_div]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [←sum_div]
  unfold acceptedTotal
  rw [RawProductLaw.legacy_box_sum]

theorem raw_good_positive : 0<RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event good := by
  rw [raw_good_event]
  exact div_pos bounded_normalizer_pos totalWeight_pos

attribute [local irreducible] RejectionDomination016.conditioned Law.map Law.uniform

noncomputable def boundedRaw : Law BoxPair :=
  RejectionDomination016.conditioned RawProductLaw.rawLaw good raw_good_positive

theorem conditioned_mass (z : BoxPair) :
    boundedRaw.mass z=(@Law.mass BoxPair boxPairFintype boundedGaussian z) := by
  unfold boundedRaw RejectionDomination016.conditioned
  change (if good z then RawProductLaw.rawLaw.mass z else 0)/RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event good=
    boundedWeight z/acceptedTotal
  rw [raw_mass,raw_good_event]
  have hS : acceptedTotal≠0 := ne_of_gt bounded_normalizer_pos
  have hT : totalWeight≠0 := ne_of_gt totalWeight_pos
  by_cases hz : good z
  · have he : boundedWeight z=gaussianWeight z := ite_eq_left hz
    rw [ite_eq_left hz,he]
    field_simp
  · have he : boundedWeight z=0 := ite_eq_right hz
    rw [ite_eq_right hz,he]
    simp

theorem mapped_conditioned {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (f : BoxPair → X) :
    boundedRaw.map f=(@Law.map BoxPair X boxPairFintype _ _ boundedGaussian f) := by
  apply FiberBinding.law_ext
  intro x
  rw [FiberBinding.map_mass,
    @FiberBinding.map_mass BoxPair X boxPairFintype _ _ boundedGaussian f x]
  simp_rw [conditioned_mass]
  exact (RawProductLaw.legacy_box_sum (fun z => if f z=x then (@Law.mass BoxPair boxPairFintype boundedGaussian z) else 0)).symm

/-- The already named M suffices; no new global theta estimate is assumed. -/
theorem global_tail_from_mass (h : Rq) (hm : MassCondition h) :
    RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event (fun z => ¬good z)≤1/2^24 := by
  have hs := (total_bounds h hm).1
  have hc := complement RawProductLaw.rawLaw good
  rw [raw_good_event] at hc
  have hlo : 1-u≤acceptedTotal/totalWeight :=
    (le_div_iff₀ totalWeight_pos).mpr hs
  change RawProductLaw.rawLaw.event (fun z => ¬good z)≤u
  linarith

#print axioms raw_mass
#print axioms raw_good_event
#print axioms raw_good_positive
#print axioms conditioned_mass
#print axioms mapped_conditioned
#print axioms global_tail_from_mass
end FT1536.S05.RawConditioning016

import CapDomination016

set_option exponentiation.threshold 100000
namespace FT1536.S05.RawPairDomination016
open Finset FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding CapExecution016 CapDomination016
variable {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]

theorem some_mass (p : Law (Option A)) : (∑ a,p.mass (some a))=1-p.mass none := by
  have hh := p.total
  rw [Fintype.sum_option] at hh
  linarith

noncomputable def accepted (p : Law (Option A)) (hp : p.mass none<1) : Law A :=
  Law.weighted (fun a => p.mass (some a)) (fun a => p.nonneg (some a))
    (by rw [some_mass]; linarith)

theorem accepted_factor (p : Law (Option A)) (hp : p.mass none<1) (a : A) :
    p.mass (some a)=(1-p.mass none)*(accepted p hp).mass a := by
  change p.mass (some a)=(1-p.mass none)*(p.mass (some a)/(∑ a,p.mass (some a)))
  rw [some_mass]
  have hn : 1-p.mass none≠0 := by linarith
  field_simp

theorem accepted_domination (p : Law (Option A)) (hp : p.mass none<1) (g : Law A) (K : ℝ)
    (bound : ∀ a,p.mass (some a)≤(1-p.mass none)*K*g.mass a) :
    ∀ a,(accepted p hp).mass a≤K*g.mass a := by
  intro a
  change p.mass (some a)/(∑ a,p.mass (some a))≤_
  rw [some_mass]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0<1-p.mass none)).2
  simpa only [mul_assoc,mul_comm,mul_left_comm] using bound a

theorem pair_numeric : (1+1/(2 : ℝ)^100)+(7/16)^80*2^23≤CoarseBudget016.pairFactor := by
  norm_num [CoarseBudget016.pairFactor]

theorem cap80_domination (p : Law (Option A)) (g : Law A) (zero : A)
    (rejection : p.mass none≤(7/16 : ℝ))
    (raw : ∀ a,p.mass (some a)≤(1-p.mass none)*(1+1/2^100)*g.mass a)
    (zero_mass : 1/(2 : ℝ)^23≤g.mass zero) :
    ∀ a,(fallbackLaw p 80 (Law.pure zero)).mass a≤CoarseBudget016.pairFactor*g.mass a := by
  have hp : p.mass none<1 := by linarith
  have hz : 0<g.mass zero := (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2^23).trans_le zero_mass
  have hu : ∀ a,(Law.pure zero).mass a≤(2 : ℝ)^23*g.mass a := by
    intro a
    have hh := pure_domination g zero hz a
    have hi : 1/g.mass zero≤(2 : ℝ)^23 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hz).2
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left zero_mass (by positivity : 0≤(2 : ℝ)^23)]
    exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (g.nonneg a))
  have hh := fallback_domination p (accepted p hp) (Law.pure zero) g (accepted_factor p hp)
    (1+1/2^100) (7/16) (2^23) (by positivity) (accepted_domination p hp g _ raw) hu rejection 80
  intro a
  exact (hh a).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right pair_numeric (g.nonneg a))

#print axioms some_mass
#print axioms accepted_factor
#print axioms accepted_domination
#print axioms pair_numeric
#print axioms cap80_domination
end FT1536.S05.RawPairDomination016

import Run2.LegalKeyErrorTransfer
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset

-- Local instance hygiene: keep the inherited choice-based declarations
-- unchanged, but use the canonical Pi/Prod enumerations in this proof.
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxVecFintype
attribute [-instance] FT1536.PublicSimulation.boxPairFintype

namespace FT1536.Run2.RawProductLaw
open Finset PublicSimulation Geometry ExactCounting LegalKeyErrorTransfer PublicErrorIdentity

abbrev Block := Fin 131071 × Fin 131071
def blockDecode (b : Block) : ℤ×ℤ := ((b.1.val : ℤ)-65535,(b.2.val : ℤ)-65535)
def blockEnergy (b : Block) : ℤ := Geometry.block (blockDecode b).1 (blockDecode b).2
noncomputable def blockWeight (b : Block) : ℝ := Real.exp (-(blockEnergy b : ℝ)/1179648)
noncomputable def blockNormalizer : ℝ := ∑ b : Block, blockWeight b

theorem blockNormalizer_pos : 0<blockNormalizer := by
  unfold blockNormalizer
  exact sum_pos (fun _ _ => Real.exp_pos _) univ_nonempty

noncomputable def blockLaw : Law Block :=
  Law.weighted blockWeight (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) blockNormalizer_pos

theorem exp_pair_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (a b : I → ℤ) (d : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-((∑ i,a i)+(∑ i,b i) : ℤ)/d)=
      (∏ i,Real.exp (-(a i : ℝ)/d))*(∏ i,Real.exp (-(b i : ℝ)/d)) := by
  rw [← Real.exp_sum, ← Real.exp_sum, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_sum, ← sum_div, sum_neg_distrib]
  ring

theorem actual_weight_product (z : BoxPair) :
    gaussianWeight z=(∏ i : Fin 768,blockWeight (z.1 i))*(∏ i : Fin 768,blockWeight (z.2 i)) := by
  have hh := exp_pair_sum (fun i : Fin 768 => blockEnergy (z.1 i))
    (fun i : Fin 768 => blockEnergy (z.2 i)) 1179648
  simpa only [gaussianWeight, Q, Q0, decode, decodeVec, blockWeight, blockEnergy, blockDecode,
    show (2*768^2 : ℝ)=1179648 by norm_num] using hh

theorem vector_product_sum (f : Block → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : BoxVec, ∏ i : Fin 768, f (v i))=(∑ b : Block,f b)^768 := by
  simpa only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun _ : Fin 768 => f)).symm

theorem vector_product_sum_family (f : Fin 768 → Block → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : BoxVec, ∏ i : Fin 768,f i (v i))=∏ i : Fin 768,∑ b : Block,f i b :=
  (Fintype.prod_sum f).symm

theorem vector_weight_sum :
    (∑ v : BoxVec, ∏ i : Fin 768, blockWeight (v i))=blockNormalizer^768 :=
  vector_product_sum blockWeight

/- A single explicit boundary transport, instead of forcing DEFEQ between
   Fintype.ofFinite and piFinset during every generic lemma application. -/
theorem legacy_box_sum (f : BoxPair → ℝ) :
    @Finset.sum BoxPair ℝ _ (@Finset.univ BoxPair boxPairFintype) f =
      ∑ z : BoxPair,f z := by
  have hf : boxPairFintype=(inferInstance : Fintype BoxPair) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hf]

theorem totalWeight_as_sum : totalWeight=∑ z : BoxPair, gaussianWeight z := by
  rw [totalWeight, eval_count]
  simp only [ite_true]
  exact legacy_box_sum gaussianWeight

theorem actual_normalizer_product : totalWeight=blockNormalizer^1536 := by
  rw [totalWeight_as_sum]
  simp_rw [actual_weight_product]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [← mul_sum]
  rw [← sum_mul, vector_weight_sum, ← pow_add]

noncomputable def rawLaw : Law BoxPair :=
  Law.weighted gaussianWeight (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (by rw [← totalWeight_as_sum]; exact totalWeight_pos)

noncomputable def vectorLaw : Law BoxVec where
  mass v := ∏ i : Fin 768, blockLaw.mass (v i)
  nonneg v := prod_nonneg fun i _ => blockLaw.nonneg (v i)
  total := by
    rw [vector_product_sum, blockLaw.total, one_pow]

noncomputable def productLaw : Law BoxPair where
  mass z := vectorLaw.mass z.1*vectorLaw.mass z.2
  nonneg z := mul_nonneg (vectorLaw.nonneg z.1) (vectorLaw.nonneg z.2)
  total := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [← mul_sum, vectorLaw.total, mul_one]
    exact vectorLaw.total

theorem actual_mass_product (z : BoxPair) : rawLaw.mass z=productLaw.mass z := by
  simp only [rawLaw, productLaw, vectorLaw, Law.weighted]
  rw [← totalWeight_as_sum, actual_normalizer_product, actual_weight_product]
  simp only [blockLaw, Law.weighted, prod_div_distrib, prod_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [div_mul_div_comm, ← pow_add]
  rfl

theorem rawLaw_eq_productLaw : rawLaw=productLaw := by
  cases hp : rawLaw with
  | mk p pn pt =>
    cases hq : productLaw with
    | mk q qn qt =>
      have hh : p=q := funext fun z => by
        have hz := actual_mass_product z
        simpa only [hp,hq] using hz
      cases hh
      rfl

def rawEvent (z : BoxPair) : Prop :=
  Q (decode z)<B ∧ publicBadSample z
noncomputable instance : DecidablePred rawEvent := Classical.decPred _

theorem rawBad_is_event : rawBad=rawLaw.event rawEvent := by
  classical
  rw [rawBad, eval_count,
    legacy_box_sum (fun z => if Q (decode z)<B ∧ publicBadSample z then gaussianWeight z else 0),
    Law.event, sum_div]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  change (if Q (decode z)<B ∧ publicBadSample z then gaussianWeight z else 0)/totalWeight =
    if rawEvent z then gaussianWeight z/(∑ y,gaussianWeight y) else 0
  rw [← totalWeight_as_sum]
  by_cases h : Q (decode z)<B ∧ publicBadSample z
  · have he : rawEvent z := h
    rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left he]
  · have he : ¬rawEvent z := h
    rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right he, zero_div]

theorem rawBad_is_product_event : rawBad=productLaw.event rawEvent := by
  rw [rawBad_is_event, rawLaw_eq_productLaw]

end FT1536.Run2.RawProductLaw

import CapExecution016

/- Q-SAMPLER: domination through rejection with normalization cancellation.
   Arbitrary finite laws; neither TV nor successful-only final laws are used. -/
namespace FT1536.S05.RejectionDomination016
open Finset FT1536.Run2.FiberBinding FiniteLaw016 CapExecution016
variable {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]

def accept (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a : A) : Option A :=
  if good a then some a else none
noncomputable def reject (p : Law A) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Law (Option A) :=
  p.map (accept good)
noncomputable def conditioned (p : Law A) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    (hp : 0<p.event good) : Law A :=
  Law.weighted (fun a => if good a then p.mass a else 0)
    (by intro a; split_ifs; exact p.nonneg a; rfl) hp

theorem complement (p : Law A) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
    p.event good+p.event (fun a => ¬good a)=1 := by
  rw [Law.event,Law.event,←sum_add_distrib,←p.total]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : good a <;> simp [ha]

theorem reject_none (p : Law A) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
    (reject p good).mass none=p.event (fun a => ¬good a) := by
  rw [reject,map_mass]
  unfold Law.event
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : good a <;> simp [accept,ha]

theorem reject_some (p : Law A) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a : A) :
    (reject p good).mass (some a)=if good a then p.mass a else 0 := by
  rw [reject,map_mass]
  have hi (x : A) : (if accept good x=some a then p.mass x else 0)=
      if x=a then (if good a then p.mass a else 0) else 0 := by
    by_cases hx : x=a
    · subst x; by_cases ha : good a <;> simp [accept,ha]
    · by_cases hg : good x <;> simp [accept,hg,hx]
  simp_rw [hi]
  simp

theorem reject_factor (p : Law A) (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    (hp : 0<p.event good) (a : A) :
    (reject p good).mass (some a)=(1-(reject p good).mass none)*(conditioned p good hp).mass a := by
  rw [reject_some,reject_none]
  have hh := complement p good
  have he : 1-p.event (fun a => ¬good a)=p.event good := by linarith
  rw [he]
  change _=p.event good*((if good a then p.mass a else 0)/p.event good)
  field_simp

theorem event_domination (p q : Law A) (C : ℝ) (hd : ∀ a,p.mass a≤C*q.mass a)
    (event : A → Prop) [DecidablePred event] : p.event event≤C*q.event event := by
  unfold Law.event
  rw [mul_sum]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : event a
  · simpa only [ha,ite_true] using hd a
  · simp [ha]

theorem domination_one_le (p q : Law A) (C : ℝ) (hd : ∀ a,p.mass a≤C*q.mass a) : 1≤C := by
  have hh := sum_le_sum (fun a (_ : a ∈ univ) => hd a)
  rwa [←mul_sum,p.total,q.total,mul_one] at hh

theorem acceptance_lower (p q : Law A) (C r : ℝ) (hd : ∀ a,p.mass a≤C*q.mass a)
    (good : A → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (tail : q.event (fun a => ¬good a)≤r) :
    1-C*r≤p.event good := by
  have hC := domination_one_le p q C hd
  have hh := event_domination p q C hd (fun a => ¬good a)

import Run2.LawBinding

namespace FT1536.Run2
open Finset
open FT1536.Relation

namespace Dist
theorem same_trans {α : Type} {p q r : Dist α} (h : Same p q) (k : Same q r) : Same p r :=
  fun f => (h f).trans (k f)
theorem same_symm {α : Type} {p q : Dist α} (h : Same p q) : Same q p := fun f => (h f).symm
theorem same_bind {α β : Type} {p q : Dist α} {f g : α → Dist β}
    (hp : Same p q) (hf : ∀ a,Same (f a) (g a)) : Same (p.bind f) (q.bind g) := by
  intro h
  simp only [expect_bind]
  rw [hp]
  exact expect_congr q _ _ (fun x => hf x h)
theorem same_map {α β : Type} {p q : Dist α} (h : Same p q) (f : α → β) :
    Same (p.map f) (q.map f) := fun g => h (fun x => g (f x))
end Dist

theorem uniform_equiv {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    [DecidableEq β] (e : α ≃ β) : (Law.uniform : Law α).map e = Law.uniform := by
  classical
  apply FiberBinding.law_ext
  intro y
  rw [FiberBinding.map_mass]
  have hxy (x : α) : e x=y ↔ x=e.symm y := (e.eq_symm_apply).symm
  simp only [Law.uniform,hxy,sum_ite_eq',mem_univ,ite_true]
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e]

theorem uniform_joint {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] :
    Divergence.joint (Law.uniform : Law α) (fun _ => (Law.uniform : Law β)) = Law.uniform := by
  apply FiberBinding.law_ext
  intro z
  simp only [Divergence.joint,Law.uniform,Fintype.card_prod,Nat.cast_mul]
  ring

def consEquiv (C : Type) (n : ℕ) : (C × (Fin n → C)) ≃ (Fin (n+1) → C) where
  toFun z := fun i => Fin.cases z.1 z.2 i
  invFun f := (f 0,fun i => f i.succ)
  left_inv z := by cases z; rfl
  right_inv f := by funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

theorem uniform_split_expect {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (α×β))).expect f =
      (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law α)).expect (fun a =>
        (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law β)).expect (fun b => f (a,b))) := by
  rw [←uniform_joint]
  change (∑ ab : α×β, (Law.uniform : Law α).mass ab.1*(Law.uniform : Law β).mass ab.2*f ab) =
    ∑ a,(Law.uniform : Law α).mass a*∑ b,(Law.uniform : Law β).mass b*f (a,b)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [mul_sum,mul_assoc]

theorem iid_is_uniform (n : ℕ) :
    Dist.Same (Reader.iid n) (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Rq))) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f
    have he (cs : Fin 0 → Rq) : cs=(fun i => Fin.elim0 i) := by funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
    rw [Reader.iid,Dist.expect_pure]
    have hh : (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (Fin 0 → Rq))).expect f = f (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) := by
      unfold Dist.expect
      simp_rw [he]
      rw [←sum_mul,Law.total,one_mul]
    exact hh.symm
  | succ n ih =>

import Run2.LawBinding

namespace FT1536.Run2
open Finset
open FT1536.Relation

namespace Dist
theorem same_trans {α : Type} {p q r : Dist α} (h : Same p q) (k : Same q r) : Same p r :=
  fun f => (h f).trans (k f)
theorem same_symm {α : Type} {p q : Dist α} (h : Same p q) : Same q p := fun f => (h f).symm
theorem same_bind {α β : Type} {p q : Dist α} {f g : α → Dist β}
    (hp : Same p q) (hf : ∀ a,Same (f a) (g a)) : Same (p.bind f) (q.bind g) := by
  intro h
  simp only [expect_bind]
  rw [hp]
  exact expect_congr q _ _ (fun x => hf x h)
theorem same_map {α β : Type} {p q : Dist α} (h : Same p q) (f : α → β) :
    Same (p.map f) (q.map f) := fun g => h (fun x => g (f x))
end Dist

theorem uniform_equiv {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    [DecidableEq β] (e : α ≃ β) : (Law.uniform : Law α).map e = Law.uniform := by
  classical
  apply FiberBinding.law_ext
  intro y
  rw [FiberBinding.map_mass]
  have hxy (x : α) : e x=y ↔ x=e.symm y := (e.eq_symm_apply).symm
  simp only [Law.uniform,hxy,sum_ite_eq',mem_univ,ite_true]
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e]

theorem uniform_joint {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] :
    Divergence.joint (Law.uniform : Law α) (fun _ => (Law.uniform : Law β)) = Law.uniform := by
  apply FiberBinding.law_ext
  intro z
  simp only [Divergence.joint,Law.uniform,Fintype.card_prod,Nat.cast_mul]
  ring

def consEquiv (C : Type) (n : ℕ) : (C × (Fin n → C)) ≃ (Fin (n+1) → C) where
  toFun z := fun i => Fin.cases z.1 z.2 i
  invFun f := (f 0,fun i => f i.succ)
  left_inv z := by cases z; rfl
  right_inv f := by funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

theorem uniform_split_expect {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (α×β))).expect f =
      (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law α)).expect (fun a =>
        (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law β)).expect (fun b => f (a,b))) := by
  rw [←uniform_joint]
  change (∑ ab : α×β, (Law.uniform : Law α).mass ab.1*(Law.uniform : Law β).mass ab.2*f ab) =
    ∑ a,(Law.uniform : Law α).mass a*∑ b,(Law.uniform : Law β).mass b*f (a,b)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [mul_sum,mul_assoc]

theorem iid_is_uniform (n : ℕ) :
    Dist.Same (Reader.iid n) (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Rq))) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f
    have he (cs : Fin 0 → Rq) : cs=(fun i => Fin.elim0 i) := by funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
    rw [Reader.iid,Dist.expect_pure]
    have hh : (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (Fin 0 → Rq))).expect f = f (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) := by
      unfold Dist.expect
      simp_rw [he]
      rw [←sum_mul,Law.total,one_mul]
    exact hh.symm
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f
    have he := uniform_equiv (consEquiv Rq n)
    have hm := draw_pushforward (Law.uniform : Law (Rq × (Fin n → Rq)))
      (consEquiv Rq n) Dist.pure f
    rw [he] at hm
    simp only [Dist.expect_bind,Dist.expect_pure] at hm
    rw [hm,uniform_split_expect]
    simp only [Reader.iid,Dist.expect_bind,Dist.expect_map]
    apply Dist.expect_congr
    intro c
    exact ih (fun tail => f (fun i => Fin.cases c tail i))

theorem vector_targets_iid (n : ℕ) :
    Dist.Same ((Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (List.Vector Rq n))).map (Equiv.vectorEquivFin Rq n))
      (Reader.iid n) := by
  have he := uniform_equiv (Equiv.vectorEquivFin Rq n)
  have hh : Dist.Same ((Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (List.Vector Rq n))).map (Equiv.vectorEquivFin Rq n))
      (Dist.draw (Law.uniform : Law (Fin n → Rq))) := by
    intro f
    have hm := draw_pushforward (Law.uniform : Law (List.Vector Rq n))
      (Equiv.vectorEquivFin Rq n) Dist.pure f
    rw [he] at hm
    simp only [Dist.expect_bind,Dist.expect_pure] at hm
    exact hm.symm
  exact Dist.same_trans hh (Dist.same_symm (iid_is_uniform n))

end FT1536.Run2

# Reproducible public integer literals. Hash equality is provenance, not analysis.
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,hashlib
src=Path(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(sys.argv[2]);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
t=json.loads(src.read_text());w=[ZZ(x) for x in t['weights']];v=[ZZ(x) for x in t['acceptance_thresholds']]
assert len(w)==30721 and len(v)==61441 and min(w)>0 and min(v)>=0 and max(v)<=2^256
cdf=[];s=ZZ(0)
for x in w:s+=x;cdf.append(s)
chunks=[];names={}
for label,values in [('cdf',cdf),('threshold',v)]:
 names[label]=[]
 for j,start in enumerate(range(0,len(values),256)):
  name=label+'_'+str(j).zfill(3);names[label].append(name)
  chunks.append('def '+name+' : Array Nat := #['+','.join(str(x) for x in values[start:start+256])+']\n')
modules=[]
for j,start in enumerate(range(0,len(chunks),32)):
 name='PublicTables016_'+str(j).zfill(2);p=out/(name+'.lean')
 p.write_text('/- Generated public table literals; regenerate with GENERATE_TABLES_016.sage. -/\nnamespace FT1536.S05.TableData016\n'+''.join(chunks[start:start+32])+'end FT1536.S05.TableData016\n')
 modules.append({'module':name,'source':str(p.resolve()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size})
index=out/'PublicTables016.lean'
index.write_text(''.join('import '+r['module']+'\n' for r in modules)+'namespace FT1536.S05.TableData016\n'+
 'def cdfChunks : Array (Array Nat) := #['+','.join(names['cdf'])+']\n'+
 'def thresholdChunks : Array (Array Nat) := #['+','.join(names['threshold'])+']\n'+
 'def cdf (i : Nat) : Nat := ((cdfChunks.getD (i/256) #[]).getD (i%256) 0)\n'+
 'def threshold (i : Nat) : Nat := ((thresholdChunks.getD (i/256) #[]).getD (i%256) 0)\n'+
 'end FT1536.S05.TableData016\n')
modules.append({'module':'PublicTables016','source':str(index.resolve()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':index.stat().st_size})
(out/'MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps({'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'modules':modules,'cdf_entries':len(cdf),'threshold_entries':len(v),'total':str(s)},indent=2)+'\n')
